ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Moon and Jupiter at {H:1807799241000}

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The Moon and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: emotion and intuition, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.
